title: Viewability
description: The surface's measurement of whether a human could have seen the placement. Thresholds follow Media Rating Council definitions.
$comment:
MRC thresholds, restated for reference:
  display        >=50% of pixels in view for >=1 continuous second
  video          >=50% of pixels in view for >=2 continuous seconds
  large display  >=242000 px creative: >=30% for >=1 second
Buyers reconcile against accredited measurement. A bespoke viewability definition cannot be priced against a rate card.

Several conformant UAP surfaces have no pixels: a CLI, an API response, an MCP tool result. These measure `delivered_only`, which is weaker evidence and is priced as such under SPEC.md §9.3. The alternative -- permitting a pixel-less surface to assert viewability -- is the cheapest available method of rate-card inflation.

rendered.description: The placement was composed into output returned to the client.
rendered.$comment: Necessary but not sufficient for billing.

standard.description: The measurement standard `viewable` was evaluated against.
standard.$comment:
mrc_display        >=50% of pixels for >=1 continuous second
  mrc_video          >=50% of pixels for >=2 continuous seconds
  mrc_large_display  >=242000 px creative: >=30% for >=1 second
  audible_playback   voice surfaces: disclosure and creative played to completion, not skipped
  delivered_only     the surface cannot observe visibility; not a viewability claim

viewable.description: True only if the threshold named by `standard` was met. Absent or false when `standard` is `delivered_only`.

method.$comment: `declared` denotes an operator assertion made without instrumentation and is treated as self-reported. `none` pairs with `delivered_only`.

visible_ms.description: Continuous milliseconds the placement met the pixel threshold.
visible_ms.$comment: The distribution of this value across a node's traffic is a stronger fraud signal than any individual receipt. An implausibly narrow distribution indicates synthesis.

visible_pct.description: Peak percentage of the placement's area in view during the measurement window.

user_present.description: The surface observed evidence of a human in the session -- focus, input, scroll, or playback control -- within the measurement window.
user_present.$comment: Distinct from viewability. A placement can be pixel-viewable in an unattended tab.

ivt.description: Invalid traffic classification applied before submission.
ivt.$comment: Filtering upstream costs less than disputing at settlement.

measurement_agent.description: An independent measurement vendor that corroborated this receipt.

mrc_accredited.description: Whether the named vendor holds MRC accreditation for the corroborated metric.
mrc_accredited.$comment: Buyers commonly require accreditation before paying on measured rates rather than delivered rates.

ivt.description: Invalid traffic classification using the MRC two-category framework.

classification.description: The classification assigned by the filtering party.
classification.$comment:
valid         passed the filtration applied
  givt          General Invalid Traffic: list-based filtration (data-center ranges, declared
                bots, crawlers, non-browser user agents)
  sivt          Sophisticated Invalid Traffic: requires analytics and multi-point corroboration
  unclassified  no filtration applied
Trust tier 0 supply is by construction indistinguishable from GIVT: an anonymous binary in a loop is the exact target of list-based filtration. This is why SPEC.md §9.3 forbids selling tier 0 on CPM. Implementations SHOULD NOT report tier 0 traffic as `valid`.

filtered_reason.description: Registry key identifying why traffic was filtered.

filter_version.description: Version of the filtration list or model applied.
filter_version.$comment: Required to replay a settlement dispute.

allOf.title: delivered_only cannot assert viewability
allOf.$comment: Enforced structurally rather than stated in prose. This is the field buyers price against.

allOf.title: A viewable impression must carry its evidence
allOf.$comment: An unevidenced viewability claim is a self-report and belongs under method `declared`.
